name: isCustomFunction
description: Determines whether a name represents a custom function

params.name: name
params.description: Name of a custom function. Must not be in quotation marks. If not a defined variable or function name, Lucee generates an error.

params.name: type
params.description:
Limit to a specific type:

- closure
- lambda
- udf

If not specified, all custom function types are accepted.
